description: Fetch one URL with conditional GET; extract, date, score as topic fit x page shape, classify index/catalog/article and source type; honour the dashboard's per-host policy (ignore skips the fetch, index-only fetches for links only); blobstore the text; queue discovered links deduped and depth-capped.
name: Scout Fetch

description: Insights are now REPLACED per run instead of accumulating; diagnostics over articles only.
name: Scout Health

description: Index the OWNER'S own published articles from their sitemap (urls + lastmod only, never page bodies). Writes solely to p-scout-owned so the owner's content can never enter the findings corpus.
name: Scout Owned Inventory

description: Re-queue every known source host's root and busiest sections into the frontier; conditional GETs make unchanged pages a 304. Honours brief.denyHosts and the per-host policy log; capped per run.
name: Scout Recrawl

description: Widen the crawl via a search API (brave|tavily|serper, whichever key is present). Emits frontierCandidates at depth 0, deduped against the registry and filtered by the brief's denyHosts. Key via $SEARCH_API_KEY, never in a token.
name: Scout Search

description: Onboard a website by harvesting its own sitemap: robots.txt then conventional locations, index files walked to article lists, non-articles filtered, registry-deduped, bounded per run. Hosts a human set to index-only or ignore are not harvested.
name: Scout Sitemap Harvest

description: Deterministic rollup + expansion tracking. 1.4.0: fresh evidence goes to the analyst as compact cards (summary + key points for every fresh finding, clipped body text only for the newest few), and analysis re-runs after a fallback answer are bounded per day via p-scout-errors.
name: Scout Taxonomy

description: Put the cost where the decisions are made: read master's measured per-transition usage for the last 24h and file one compact usage-day token (totals, fires, per-lane breakdown with tier/group) into p-scout-usage; keeps 30 days.
name: Scout Usage Rollup

description: Draft ONE accepted article task with the local claude binary from a KNOWLEDGE PACK ranked across the whole corpus (competitor piece + best passages from other sources + cards), stored as its own blob; the article goes to the blobstore and the draft token carries only preview, outline, counts and blob urns. Env TASK_ID drafts a named task (always writes); WRITER_MODEL picks the claude model alias.
name: Scout Write (Claude Code)

description: The same knowledge-pack writer, driven by the dashboard for ONE named task and a named model (TASK_ID + WRITER_MODEL). On demand only; blob-backed and revisioned; the draft token stays small.
name: Scout Write (named model, on demand)
